description: Turn off one of your short links so it stops redirecting, keeping its destination and clicks. Generated codes are never reassigned; use reactivate_url to turn the link back on, or delete_url to erase it for good.

code.description: The link's short code (e.g. AbCdEf, or launch for gajo.io/c/launch). A full short URL also works.

name: deactivate_url
title: Deactivate a short link
